column1: # The tracker's dated log (build.py reads this file; add_record.py appends to it). Oldest line first; the page shows newest first.
#   date           the day the entry was written (UTC), as YYYY-MM-DD
#   kind           state | addition | correction | wording | note
#   saved id       the record the entry is about (a folder name under research/primary), or "-"
#   records after  the number of records in data/figure_data.txt after this entry (build.py checks the last line against the file)
#   text           the entry as shown. Between straight double quotes go ONLY exact words of the saved copy named in column 3.
#   checks         optional, not shown: "id | words" must stand in that saved copy; "NOT id | words" must not (6 characters or more);
#                  "NOTWORD id | word" says a short word does not stand in the page as a whole word. Several are joined by " ;; ".
# A time in an entry's text (06:07 UTC) is the time the figure and the argument were corrected, from the project's own record.

column5: The state of play now uses the words the core gave the same statements on Nov 25, 2026. The commission's record of Nvidia's filings, fetched again on Nov 25, 2026 at 06:49 UTC, still lists no report for the quarter ended Oct 25, 2026. The state's declared policy and its regulators pressed the companies to move away from Nvidia chips. The two news pages carry Nvidia's statement in their reports of the licence table; neither says on which day it was made, so the item no longer says it came after the table was made public. The page that quotes the statement at more length is The Daily Caller's; the spokesperson's words were told to the Daily Caller News Foundation. Each row of the licence table names a data-centre operator or ultimate consignee; the applications returned without action include every one whose ultimate location is Malaysia, Indonesia or Thailand; and the share counted with the 445,000 as a further application holds only if that application was not returned without action. In the key, Qiushi is named as the journal Qiushi, and the two universities' notices are their own buying, not an act of the central government. Three things said in earlier entries, which stay as written, read so now: the commerce ministry's reply of Aug 19, 2026 speaks only of exporters and export controls; our English for the Micron conclusion is shall stop buying; and the page the entries of Nov 25, 2026 give to the Daily Caller News Foundation is The Daily Caller's.
